description: Mechanical cross-check of contraction_mixed_witness.md: the four combined-endpoint orbits (T1, T2a, T2b, T2c) at a Type N vertex, the NPT-theta / 4-branch-fan / vertex-hub arithmetic, and two new arithmetic lemmas (E: 2^x+2^y-1 never a power of two; F: 2^s+2 never a power of two) plus two supporting identities.
scope_note: Tests only unconditional graph-theoretic/arithmetic mechanics: the orbit-counting result and the exact cycle-length arithmetic of every clean configuration in the summary table, by direct gadget construction. Does not test whether these clean configurations actually occur in a minimal counterexample (that depends on the still-open non-clean-overlap case from contraction_atoms.md Part V). Kept separate from contraction_lift.py / atom_lift.py / neighborhood_lift.py, none of which are touched.
note_on_python_version: Same environment note as prior manifests: requirements.txt/.python-version pin CPython 3.14.6, unavailable in this container; this run used 3.13.12 with networkx==3.6.1 (matches requirements.txt's pin exactly).
detector_agreement: Every constructed gadget cycle validated by two independent implementations (hand-rolled adjacency traversal verify_cycle, and independently constructed networkx traversal verify_cycle_nx, both imported from verifier/contraction_lift.py); 0 disagreements.
completed_range: All arithmetic ranges and gadget parameter tuples processed to completion (no partial/timeout runs).
